{
  "meta": {
    "title": "Rate limiters: shared bucket, slow store",
    "topicClass": "concept",
    "format": "full",
    "targetLengthSec": 90
  },
  "story": {
    "devices": [
      "seen_this_bug",
      "object_to_data",
      "versus_split",
      "what_breaks",
      "planted_question",
      "failure_before_fix",
      "real_incident",
      "question_chapters"
    ],
    "hook": {
      "kind": "problem"
    },
    "runningExample": "A single checkout request from one user at Larkspur Pay flows through the gateway and asks the rate limiter for a token.",
    "chapters": [
      {
        "id": "ch1",
        "title": "Why not a bucket per node?",
        "question": "Why not keep a bucket on each gateway node?"
      },
      {
        "id": "ch2",
        "title": "What breaks when the store slows?",
        "question": "What breaks when the shared store gets slow?"
      }
    ],
    "beats": [
      {
        "id": "beat1",
        "chapterId": "ch1",
        "intent": "Open on checkout failing for 47 minutes with 31% of requests refused, and name the part that let too much traffic through: a rate limiter.",
        "device": "seen_this_bug",
        "targetSec": 8,
        "factIds": [
          "fact-18"
        ],
        "hookNumberIds": [
          "num-15",
          "num-14"
        ],
        "continuesPrevious": false,
        "layoutMode": "two_column",
        "newTerms": [
          "Rate limiter"
        ]
      },
      {
        "id": "beat2",
        "chapterId": "ch1",
        "intent": "Turn one checkout request into a key and show its token bucket: capacity 100, refill 10 per second, each request spends one token.",
        "device": "object_to_data",
        "targetSec": 10,
        "factIds": [
          "fact-1",
          "fact-3",
          "num-1",
          "num-2"
        ],
        "continuesPrevious": false,
        "layoutMode": "centered_focus",
        "newTerms": [
          "Token bucket"
        ]
      },
      {
        "id": "beat3",
        "chapterId": "ch1",
        "intent": "Compare keeping a bucket on each of 24 gateway nodes against one shared bucket: a client spread across nodes gets 24 times its limit.",
        "device": "versus_split",
        "targetSec": 12,
        "factIds": [
          "fact-7",
          "num-3",
          "num-4"
        ],
        "continuesPrevious": false,
        "layoutMode": "versus_split",
        "suggestedPatternIds": [
          "versus_split"
        ],
        "newTerms": [
          "Shared store"
        ]
      },
      {
        "id": "beat4",
        "chapterId": "ch1",
        "intent": "Show what breaks without an indivisible read-compute-write: two gateway nodes read the same token count, both see a token left and both admit a request.",
        "device": "what_breaks",
        "targetSec": 12,
        "factIds": [
          "fact-6",
          "fact-5"
        ],
        "continuesPrevious": true
      },
      {
        "id": "beat5",
        "chapterId": "ch2",
        "intent": "Plant the question of what happens when the shared store gets slow, then show the cost of the network trip: 0.4 ms median and 2.1 ms p99.",
        "device": "planted_question",
        "targetSec": 10,
        "factIds": [
          "fact-8",
          "num-5",
          "num-6"
        ],
        "continuesPrevious": false,
        "layoutMode": "stacked_list"
      },
      {
        "id": "beat6",
        "chapterId": "ch2",
        "intent": "A routine failover moves the store to another zone and store calls jump from 1 ms to 80 ms, past the timeout.",
        "device": "failure_before_fix",
        "targetSec": 12,
        "factIds": [
          "fact-19",
          "num-17",
          "num-16"
        ],
        "continuesPrevious": false,
        "layoutMode": "centered_focus"
      },
      {
        "id": "beat7",
        "chapterId": "ch2",
        "intent": "The failure policy makes each instance enforce the limit locally, so traffic reaches roughly 40 times the contracted rate and 31% of checkouts fail.",
        "device": "real_incident",
        "targetSec": 12,
        "factIds": [
          "fact-20",
          "fact-21"
        ],
        "continuesPrevious": false,
        "layoutMode": "hub_spoke",
        "source": "Larkspur Pay platform team incident report, 14 Mar 2025"
      },
      {
        "id": "beat8",
        "chapterId": "ch2",
        "intent": "Show the fix: fail closed for the provider, fallback limits divided by instance count, and store timeout raised above 150 ms.",
        "device": "real_incident",
        "targetSec": 14,
        "factIds": [
          "fact-23",
          "num-20"
        ],
        "continuesPrevious": false,
        "layoutMode": "grid",
        "source": "Larkspur Pay platform team incident report, 14 Mar 2025"
      }
    ],
    "plantedQuestion": {
      "text": "What happens when the shared store gets slow?",
      "beatId": "beat5",
      "payoffBeatId": "beat7"
    },
    "rejectedAlternative": {
      "beatId": "beat3",
      "summary": "Give every gateway node its own token bucket; a client spread across 24 nodes would get 24 times its limit.",
      "chosenBeatId": "beat4"
    },
    "ending": {
      "kind": "spec_card_ending",
      "cta": "Follow for more system design trade-offs in under a minute.",
      "specCard": {
        "lines": [
          "One shared bucket per key",
          "Atomic read-compute-write",
          "Fail closed when store is slow"
        ]
      }
    }
  }
}
